# heic-to 1.5.2 (vendored)

Converts HEIC/HEIF photos (the iPhone default) in browsers that cannot open them natively.
Loaded on demand by `src/app.js`, only when a HEIC photo is chosen and the browser fails to decode it.

- Source: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to (npm `heic-to@1.5.2`, file `dist/csp/heic-to.js`, unmodified)
- Licence: LGPL-3.0 (see `LICENSE`). It bundles libheif.
- To update: download the new version's `dist/csp/heic-to.js` from npm and replace the file.
